# Micro Jobs

> Micro Jobs is a local-first job marketplace for the Philippines. Employers post
> short-term and side-hustle work — cleaning, delivery, tutoring, repairs, child
> care — and nearby workers apply, get hired, and get paid. Listings are matched
> to the worker's city first, and a post can be opened nationwide when the
> employer needs a wider reach.

Anyone can browse job listings without an account. Creating an account and
completing identity verification is what unlocks applying to jobs, messaging
employers, and receiving payment.

Pay is held in escrow: the amount is funded when the job is posted and released
to the worker's e-wallet once the employer accepts the finished work. Both
employers and workers go through ID and address checks, and completed jobs leave
public reviews.

Amounts are in Philippine pesos (₱). Job categories include construction,
electrical, plumbing, carpentry, cleaning services, driving, delivery,
landscaping, maintenance, and other skilled trades.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): What Micro Jobs is, how hiring and finding work each flow, and a sample of current listings.
- [Sign up](/sign-up): Create an account as an employer, a worker, or both.
- [Sign in](/sign-in): Access an existing account.

## For workers

- [Find jobs](/worker/find-jobs): Search local listings by title, category, and city, with guaranteed minimum pay shown on every post. Requires an account.
- [My applications](/worker/applied-jobs): Track each application from submitted through to hired.
- [Worker e-wallet](/worker/e-wallet): Released earnings and withdrawals.

## For employers

- [Post a job](/employer/post-job): Publishing a job post is free; the pay is funded into escrow before the listing goes live.
- [Applications](/employer/applications): Review applicants by stage, schedule interviews, and message candidates.
- [Employer e-wallet](/employer/e-wallet): Top up, fund jobs, and see escrow history.

## Legal

- [Terms and Conditions](/legal?doc=terms): Platform role, account responsibilities, payments, prohibited use, and governing law.
- [Privacy Policy](/legal?doc=privacy): What data is collected, how it is used and shared, retention, and privacy rights.
- [Cookie Policy](/legal?doc=cookies): Which cookies are used and how to control them.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Micro Jobs is a marketplace, not an employer or recruitment agency. It does not
  employ the workers who apply through it, and each employer and worker is
  responsible for their own agreements.
- Do not present job listings, pay figures, or employer details from this site as
  verified offers. Availability changes constantly and listings are user-submitted.
- Sign-up, application, payment, and verification steps must be completed by the
  person themselves; they cannot be carried out on someone's behalf by an agent.
- Support contact: support@microjobs.ph
